scope.implementation: Managed capture construction for recursive checked task plans through shared MLIR RecursiveRecordOps boxing, checked invocation translation and LLVM helper linkage
scope.nominal_identity: Original record tokens link to canonical destination identities; synthetic capture-record tokens retain private identity
scope.publication: Frame closure payload is published only after managed environment boxing and exact callable-code binding succeed; capture-free closures keep a null environment
scope.invocation: Generated synchronous callable entries check invocation readiness, validate code-bound captured environments before reading fields, and reject nonnull environments for capture-free entries
scope.metadata: Capture counts and structural types are checked against target parameter metadata; unsupported capture storage is rejected
scope.source_boundary: Recursive source/continuation admission gates remain unchanged; these are trusted generated checked-plan components

coverage: Captured and capture-free closures are created and returned by compiler-generated TaskEntry factories in real scheduler pools
Captured aggregate includes recursive List children, UTF-8 String captures in nested closures, duplicate function-array environments and recursive child arrays
Repeated independent observations survive producer settlement and original scheduler destruction; returned closures transfer onward through a generated identity task after observer settlement
Generated synchronous callable bodies execute against retained captures and the full nested capture graph is inspected after scheduler cleanup
Captured entries reject null and foreign environments without dereferencing them; pending task/application errors and existing numeric faults remain intact
Capture-free generated callable entries reject nonnull environment pointers
Active malformed enum tags, unknown managed links, invalid nested environments and invalid array descriptors fail graph publication; inactive garbage fields contribute no dependencies
Allocation-failure sweep reaches successful capture graph boxing and checks balanced cleanup after every failed publication attempt
Malformed checked-plan capture counts and structural types are rejected in isolated emitter fixtures
Existing generated recursive entry, transport, nested scheduling, error, cancellation, depth, allocation and cleanup cases remain in the component harness
